title: contracts: IEmailService's sendTemplate / renderTemplate Errors lists do not name TEMPLATE_INVALID, the render refusal plugin-email gains in PR #26799
body:
Filing gate ① (class b: a declared contract left incomplete by a named producer). Filed by the `domain:server` seat 3 (`session_01QSeKYmQXM3rHJcPnrEPk4B`) from the `os-dev-report` on #26660 (comment `6447779926`, `out_of_scope_findings`). ⛔ Not a claim. No `domain:*` label: triage sets lane and grade.

Blocked-by: #26673

(#26673 closes when PR #26799 merges; the code this card documents exists only after that.)

Seam: spec:IEmailService.sendTemplate/renderTemplate Errors → runtime:plugin-email EmailService.resolveAndRenderTemplate (`TEMPLATE_INVALID`), service-messaging email-channel / inbox-channel `classifyError` | consumer: service-messaging

## Measured

- PR #26799 (`Fixes #26673`, `Part of #26660`) makes `EmailService.sendTemplate` and `renderTemplate` refuse a stored template whose hole chains a second formatter or passes a non-ISO `currency` argument, by throwing `TEMPLATE_INVALID: email template <name> (locale=<l>): <hole and rule>`. In the same PR's patch round, `service-messaging` grades it permanent beside its three siblings.
- `packages/spec/src/contracts/email-service.ts`, on `origin/main`: the `sendTemplate` Errors list and the `renderTemplate` Errors list ("same vocabulary as `sendTemplate`") name `TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND`, `TEMPLATE_INACTIVE`, `MISSING_VARIABLES` only. Re-check: `git grep -n "TEMPLATE_INACTIVE\`  —" origin/main -- packages/spec/src/contracts/email-service.ts` (expected 2 hits) and `git grep -n "TEMPLATE_INVALID" origin/main -- packages/spec/src/contracts/email-service.ts` (expected 0 hits until this card lands).

## Wanted

Both Errors lists name `TEMPLATE_INVALID` (a stored template whose holes the authoring rules refuse; judged at its next publish; permanent for delivery). Documentation of the contract only: no schema change. If the contract also documents `TEMPLATE_UNSUPPORTED`, which `classifyError` already grades permanent, check it in the same edit.

**Business reason:** a channel or app author reads `IEmailService` to know which failures are final. A code the runtime throws but the contract does not list is a failure nobody handles on purpose.

Dedupe: the open-issue title index (242 open issues, read this session) has no hit for `TEMPLATE_INVALID` or the email-service Errors list.
